conbody.p: Closed periods are kept for 60 days, after which nobody can reopen them or change their postings.
Back up the ledger database and the attachments before you close the period, every time, even for a short period.
Read the closing checklist before you close the period and send the signed copy to the auditor.
Export the trial balance to the reporting folder before you close the period, then email the controller, attach the signed approval form and wait for the controller to answer before you continue.
